title: Prioritize competing commitments
prompt: Describe a time you had several important tasks and not enough time to finish them all. How did you choose priorities, communicate the trade-offs, and handle the outcome?
followUps: Which criteria determined what you deferred?
Who needed to know about the changed expectations?
How did the actual result compare with your plan?

twist.prompt: Suppose an urgent request arrives halfway through and conflicts with a promise you already made. How would you reassess and communicate?
